support.privacy: Contact details and messages stay in form memory. Only the demo receipt type, time, and status are stored for the current tab session.
support.aboutText: SolCacao is an artisanal chocolate platform for individual chocolate lovers and business partners. Discover cacao profiles, explore personalized samplers, and learn about wholesale confectionery. This student project currently demonstrates the front-end experience.
support.q1: Can I order a sampler here?
support.a1: Choose three flavors and a quantity in the sampler builder. Phase 2 validates the selection locally; ordering and delivery are not active.
support.a2: Choose Wholesale inquiry in the contact form. In this demo, no inquiry is delivered. The team will connect the backend in Phase 3.
support.q3: Where can I find allergen information?
support.a3: Before ordering, request verified ingredients and allergen details from the business. Demo flavor names do not establish dietary or allergy safety.
